goal: Bake a useful local Bio-Software paint app in Canvas, using Windows XP Paint as the Chase target; retain exact native parity as an open gate.

target.description: Windows XP Paint: raster editing, classic toolbox, palette and menus. Native XP executable not supplied.
target.reference_version: XP-era documented behavior, inspected 2026-10-14; binary and byte-exact PDF pin unavailable
target.reference_limits: Web-readable guide inspected; direct PDF byte retrieval failed certificate validation, so no invented file hash or native version pin.

may_change: Extended organism memory beyond XP Paint
Undo capacity, rasterizer and native platform integration

oven.execution: Explicit local tests and browser preview; no paid model or remote publication

acceptance: Baker review remains separate from tests; native-xp-parity remains unmet without a native reference.

anchors.statement: Expose the classic six menus, sixteen tools and twenty-eight palette slots, with usable keyboard focus.
anchors.test: Browser fixture: tool routes; manual menu and pointer checks.

anchors.statement: Provide pencil, brush, spray, fill, color picker, eraser, line, two-bend curve and area shapes on a deterministic raster.
anchors.test: node --test examples/paint/test_raster.cjs; browser shape and pointer checks.

anchors.statement: Rectangular and masked free-form selections support moving, copying, cutting, pasting, undo and redo.
anchors.test: Raster selection/history tests and browser selection/clipboard fixtures.

anchors.statement: Provide bounded nearest-neighbor stretch, skew, flips, rotations, inversion, resize, magnification and grid.
anchors.test: Raster transform inverses, dimension bounds, browser attributes and grid fixtures.

anchors.statement: Import bounded PNG, JPEG, GIF and supported BMP; export PNG, JPEG and 24-bit BMP through explicit user actions.
anchors.test: BMP round trips, PNG browser round trip, explicit local file-open and download checks.

anchors.statement: Keep a founding PRIMER, instance identity, append-only checked experience, stasis and explicit verified recovery; refuse invalid imports before changing the active Body.
anchors.test: Raster organism rejection tests and browser stasis, restoration and corrupt-import fixtures.

anchors.statement: Emit a self-contained EMIT_TEXT/0.2 Anchor thought; an isolated receiving process materializes byte-identical HTML without MantleOS.
anchors.test: python examples/paint/build.py --output NEW; isolated receiver equality and tamper refusal.

anchors.statement: Keep measured tests, described XP behavior, untested native parity and Baker acceptance separate.
anchors.test: KPP recipe/workspace validation; graph, coverage and complete refusal without Baker attestations.

anchors.statement: Perform paired native XP Paint and browser observations on a pinned executable, including visual and uncommon file/OS behavior.
anchors.test: Requires an independently supplied trusted native target and matched observations; NOT RUN.
